records.officialAcademicRequirement: Applicants should possess the following: A Master's degree in Business/Administration/Management or related fields from a university recognised by the University's Senate or an equivalent qualification. A minimum CGPA of 3.00/4.00 or equivalent. Degrees awarded by local private institutions of higher learning including those awarded under any collaborative/franchising schemes with local or foreign partner must be accredited by the Malaysian Qualifications Agency (MQA). Candidates without a related qualification in the field/s or working experience in the relevant fields will need to pass an interview and undergo appropriate pre-requisite course determined by the University.

records.researchFieldsOfficialText: The DBA Programme is delivered in 3 parts through a series of lecture seminars, consultancy, training and independent study. Part I: Theoretical Updating (18 units) Seminar in: i. Management Control and Decision Making ii. Human Capital Transformation iii. Financial Decision Making iv. Managing Technology and Decision Making v. Marketing and Global Business vi. Trend and Foresights in Business Strategy Part II: Knowledge Dissemination and Generation (21 units) This part is divided into 2 components: i. Dissemination of knowledge: The Consultation and Training Course (15 units) requires the candidate to conduct consultancy and training in a chosen field. This course is completed in 2 semesters. ii. Generation of knowledge The Research Methodology course (6 units) requires the candidate to update knowledge in research methodology, analysis techniques and software packages. The candidate needs to prepare a research proposal, which will serve as the basis for the dissertation in Part III. This course is completed in two semesters. Part III: Dissertation (42 units) This is the part where candidates are supervised through the process of a dissertation and upon completion, are examined vi

records.researchFieldsOfficialText: There are two major components in the programme: Coursework (60 units) Research/Dissertation (30 units) Courses Offered The Coursework Component Advanced Research Methodology and Statistics (12 units) This component aims to enable the candidate to master the process of educational research. The courses deal with various research methods that enable the student to learn research skills, data processing techniques, statistical analysis and the use of computers in data analysis. Major Areas of Specialisation (28 units) Candidates have to major one area of specialisation from the following: Science Education Educational Technology Curriculum and Instruction TESOL (Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages) Cognate or Substantive Courses (20 units) Candidates are required to select 5 courses from the Master's or Doctoral courses offered by the School of Educational Studies or other Schools that can support or enhance the scope and depth of the candidate's major. The Dissertation Component Candidates are required to select a research topic and carry out an intensive research study under the supervision of a lecturer/supervisor and members of the Dissertation Committee.
